messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 4.1.3

4.1.3. Fitness for purpose When lifting machinery or related products, including lifting accessories, are placed on the market or are first put into service, the manufacturer shall ensure, by taking appropriate measures or having them taken, that the machinery or related products, including lifting accessories, which are ready for use – whether manually or power-operated – can fulfil their specified functions safely. The static and dynamic tests referred to in section 4.1.2.3 shall be performed on all lifting machinery or related products ready to be put into service. Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises, the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer. Otherwise, the measures may be taken either in the manufacturer’s premises or at the place of use.

response.text:
lifting machinery and related products, including lifting accessories | mustFulfilSpecifiedFunctionsSafely | can fulfil their specified functions safely, whether manually or power-operated, when ready for use | when placed on the market or first put into service | "the manufacturer shall ensure, by taking appropriate measures or having them taken, that the machinery or related products, including lifting accessories, which are ready for use – whether manually or power-operated – can fulfil their specified functions safely"
static and dynamic tests referred to in section 4.1.2.3 | mustBePerformedOn | all lifting machinery or related products ready to be put into service | | "The static and dynamic tests referred to in section 4.1.2.3 shall be performed on all lifting machinery or related products ready to be put into service."
appropriate measures | mustBeTakenAt | the place of use by the manufacturer | where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer's premises | "Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer's premises, the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer."
appropriate measures | mayBeTakenAt | the manufacturer's premises or the place of use | otherwise, where assembly in the manufacturer's premises is possible | "Otherwise, the measures may be taken either in the manufacturer's premises or at the place of use."
